final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS n FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.sex, s.n, CAST(s.n AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.sex, s.n, s.ratio, s.n - a.avg_ratio AS excess FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS a WHERE a.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s.n > a.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(n) AS sum_n, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM step5
